title: NEW - Location page clicks fell 16-38% at 7 of 10 stores (Brookfield -38%, Sun Prairie -37%, Milwaukee PM -26%) while every page position held within 0.4 - a click-through squeeze, not a ranking loss
detail: This is the main story of the period. Site-wide, clicks fell 7.0% (22,876 -> 21,267) even though impressions ROSE 3.9% and average position IMPROVED 8.2 -> 7.7, so CTR dropped from 3.68% to 3.29%. The location pages show the same pattern even more strongly: Brookfield 565 -> 350 clicks (-38%) on impressions down only 7%, at position 3.1 -> 3.4; Sun Prairie 403 -> 255 (-37%) on impressions -10%, at 2.3 -> 2.7; Milwaukee Public Market -26%, Middleton -23%, Hilldale -20%, Whitefish Bay -19.5%, Pewaukee -16%. None of them moved more than 0.4 positions, so by the stable-position rule this is not a ranking problem. It shows up on the main brand query too: 'forage kitchen' held position 1.1 but lost 848 clicks on nearly the same impressions (-1.6%), so its CTR fell from 67.5% to 61.7%. There is one ranking signal to watch: the 'forage kitchen <city>' queries all slipped by similar small amounts - Brookfield 1.0 -> 1.6, Milwaukee 1.0 -> 1.6, Sun Prairie 1.2 -> 1.6, Whitefish Bay 1.2 -> 1.6, Champaign 1.4 -> 2.0. Each slip is under the 1.0 threshold, but they moved together. The likeliest explanation is that Google is answering more of these searches in the map pack or Business Profile (call, directions, Order button) before anyone clicks through to eatforage.com. Prior-period demand is a second factor: Sep 12-Oct 9 covered the start of the semester and warmer weather. Action: (1) In Google Business Profile > Performance, pull website clicks, calls, direction requests and order clicks for 10/10-11/6 against 9/12-10/9 for Brookfield and Sun Prairie. If profile actions held or grew, the site is just losing clicks to the profile and you only need the profiles to stay accurate. If profile actions fell too, demand dropped, so check the daily sales dashboard for the same weeks. (2) In an incognito window, search 'forage kitchen brookfield' and 'forage kitchen sun prairie' and note what ranks above eatforage.com (DoorDash, Yelp, the Brookfield Square directory, an old ordering URL). If a third-party listing holds #1, link to the location page from that listing wherever you control it.

title: STILL OPEN (7th week) - State Street CTR stuck at 0.98% even after its position IMPROVED a full point to 3.4; Champaign converts 9.9% at position 3.8
detail: This week's data closes the case. State Street took 67 clicks from 6,834 impressions. Its position improved again (3.7 -> 3.4, and 4.4 the run before) and CTR stayed flat under 1%. A page that moves up and still gets no clicks has a snippet problem, not a ranking problem. The comparison is now even wider: /locations/champaign-il, also a campus store, converts 9.9% (522 / 5,262) at a WORSE position of 3.8. Every other location page converts between 2.8% and 5.1%. If State Street reached just 3%, it would get about 205 clicks against today's 67, roughly +140 per 28 days, from one title and description edit. Action: rewrite the <title> to 'Forage Kitchen State Street - UW-Madison Campus | Bowls & Salads' and the meta description to lead with the street address, today's hours and 'Order online for pickup'. Compare it side by side with the Champaign page's title and description, since Champaign is clearly doing something right for campus searchers, and copy its structure. Also confirm the State Street Business Profile links to /locations/state-street-madison-wi and not the homepage. Re-check in two runs. If CTR is still under 2%, inspect the snippet Google actually shows (image, sitelinks, or a closed-hours label) and look for a duplicate or old State Street URL splitting the impressions.

title: STILL OPEN (7th week) - Local-discovery schema audit: five more generic queries lost outright ('salad places near me', 'food places near me', 'food delivery near me', 'restaurants in middleton wi', 'one bowl meals'); non-branded clicks -5.3%
detail: Seventh carry-forward. For the second week running, five local-discovery queries dropped to zero: 'salad places near me' (was position 6.4), 'one bowl meals' (6.7), 'food places near me' (13.4), 'food delivery near me' (13.7), and 'restaurants in middleton wi' (18.3). Last week's five were also near-me and city-name searches. Non-branded clicks fell to 1,604 (-89, -5.3%) on impressions down 4.3% (160,575 -> 153,668). A few local generics held or gained, which shows the pages can rank for them: 'salad near me' +11 clicks at a stable position 6.0, and 'brookfield restaurants' +14 with position 10.2 -> 8.0. Brookfield's page is the one getting traction, which makes it the model to copy. Action, unchanged and about an hour of work: run /locations/brookfield and /locations/middleton-wi through the Rich Results Test, side by side. Confirm every /locations/* page carries Restaurant/LocalBusiness markup with name, full postal address, geo lat/long, openingHoursSpecification, telephone, servesCuisine ('Salads', 'Grain Bowls', 'Healthy'), priceRange and hasMenu, plus an embedded Google map. Also add one plain-text sentence per page naming the neighborhood and nearby landmarks (for example 'Middleton restaurant near Greenway Station'), since 'restaurants in middleton wi' fell off at position 18.

title: NEW - Nutrition cannibalization: 'forage kitchen nutrition information' fell from #1.0 to #8.1 the same period the new /blogs/forage-kitchen-bowls-nutrition post launched; /faq lost 33% of clicks (436 -> 293)
detail: This is a real ranking drop, and the likely cause is something the site did itself. 'forage kitchen nutrition information' fell 7.1 positions (1.0 -> 8.1) and lost 23 of its 58 clicks. /faq, which held that query, slipped 4.5 -> 5.3 and lost 143 clicks (-33%) on impressions down only 17%. That is the reverse of last week's /faq recovery. In the same 28 days a new post, /blogs/forage-kitchen-bowls-nutrition, appeared at position 4.4 with 66 clicks. Two pages on the same domain now compete for the same nutrition intent, and Google is alternating between them. Neither holds #1, which is the usual sign of cannibalization. Action: pick one page to own 'forage kitchen nutrition' searches. The simplest choice is the FAQ, or whichever page links the official nutrition/allergen PDF. In the blog post, add a prominent link near the top: 'Full nutrition and allergen information for every bowl: see our nutrition guide', pointing to that page. Make sure the blog title does not repeat the exact 'Forage Kitchen Nutrition Information' wording, and keep the FAQPage schema on /faq intact. Re-check next run. Success means the query climbs back toward 1-2 with one of the two URLs consistently holding it.

title: NEW - Thanksgiving catering post climbed 10.3 -> 6.0 (+16 clicks) with ~2.5 weeks until the holiday; kombucha post jumped 9.6 -> 7.0 on +27k impressions
detail: Two content wins worth pushing on while they are timely. /blogs/thanksgiving-catering-healthy-options moved up 4.3 positions to 6.0, and its clicks rose from 4 to 20 on impressions up 152. Thanksgiving is 11/26, so the next two weeks are the whole window for this page. Separately, /blogs/kombucha-health-benefits gained 2.6 positions (9.6 -> 7.0) and 41 clicks on impressions up 27,446, the largest impression gain on the site. 'kombucha benefits' alone added 23 clicks. /blogs/how-to-make-salad-dressing also rose 12.4 -> 9.6, onto page one. Action: (1) Update the Thanksgiving catering post now with a 2026 order-by date, the catering order link above the fold, and a short list of party-pack options. Link to it from the homepage and the catering page until 11/26. This is the highest-intent blog traffic on the site, because it brings in people planning to order. (2) In the kombucha post, add a short section linking to the in-store kombucha (and /menu). 'forage kombucha' lost 33 clicks even though its position improved, so readers are not finding the product. Also consider adding FAQ schema to the post to protect its new position.

title: Follow-ups: 'black rice' back on page one (10.4 -> 9.0, +25 clicks), Monona back under the alert threshold (-13%), Champaign is the only location page growing (+18) and 'forage kitchen uiuc' jumped 4.9 -> 1.4
detail: Status on last week's items. IMPROVING - forbidden rice: last run flagged a real ranking loss after 'black rice' fell to 11.3. It has recovered to position 9.0 and gained 25 clicks (39 -> 64) on 28,796 impressions, back on page one. Downgrading to low. Still worth the planned refresh plus an internal link from /blogs/farro-vs-quinoa to lock it in. CLOSED - Monona: last week's -17% demand dip eased to -13% (247 -> 214), position 2.8 -> 3.0, now under the threshold. 'forage kitchen monona' gained 51 clicks at position 1.2. RESHUFFLES, NOT PROBLEMS: Champaign is the only location page up (504 -> 522). 'forage kitchen champaign' lost 139 clicks, but 'forage kitchen uiuc' rose from position 4.9 to 1.4 (+49), so campus searchers changed what they type and the page still gets them. Whitefish Bay works the same way: 'forage whitefish bay' -74 but 'forage kitchen whitefish bay' +83. /menu: -396 clicks with position flat (3.6 -> 3.8) and 'forage kitchen menu' +64 at 1.2, which is demand and the CTR squeeze, not rank. Sun Prairie, last week's branded-variant watch item, is now part of the network-wide CTR item above. Its page is at 2.7, under the 3.0 escalation trigger, though the -37% click drop puts it at the front of that review. IGNORE: /blogs/fermented-food lost 190 clicks and half its impressions at a dead-flat position 9.0, the same AI-overview demand absorption seen for five runs.
